neet_questions.questionText: Which of the following cell organelles is responsible for ATP synthesis?
neet_questions.explanation: Mitochondria are known as the powerhouse of the cell because they generate most of the chemical energy needed to power the cell's biochemical reactions through ATP synthesis.

neet_questions.questionText: A particle moves along a straight line with a constant acceleration. What represents the slope of the velocity-time graph?
neet_questions.explanation: The slope of a velocity-time graph at any point represents the acceleration of the object at that specific time.
